skill.name: address-github-comments
skill.description: Helps agents inspect, plan, fix, and respond to GitHub pull request comments using the GitHub CLI.
skill.summary: Address GitHub pull request review comments with a structured gh CLI workflow.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: Several markdown backtick alerts are formatting-only, but the skill intentionally uses authenticated gh commands to inspect pull requests and post comments. No prompt injection or data exfiltration intent was found, but the workflow allows unspecified custom scripts without verification.

remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval and source review before running any helper script. Prefer documented gh commands for listing review threads.
Confirm the repository, pull request number, and comment body before running gh pr comment or marking work resolved.
Recommend least-privilege GitHub tokens and avoid gh auth login on untrusted machines or shared environments.

content.user_title: Address GitHub PR Comments with gh
content.value_statement: Review comments can be missed when a pull request has many threads. This skill gives Claude, Codex, and Claude Code a structured gh CLI workflow.
actual_capabilities: Checks GitHub CLI authentication status before starting work.
Fetches pull request comments for the current branch using gh.
Organizes review comments and issue feedback into actionable fixes.
Asks for user confirmation when many comments need attention.
Guides agents to apply code changes before responding to reviewers.
Provides a gh command pattern for posting a follow-up pull request comment.
limitations: Requires the GitHub CLI to be installed and authenticated.
Does not resolve GitHub review threads through the API by itself.
Depends on the agent to inspect surrounding code before making changes.
May need user guidance for large reviews or ambiguous reviewer feedback.

use_cases.title: Triage Review Feedback
use_cases.description: Collect open pull request comments and turn them into a clear fix plan before editing code.

use_cases.title: Prepare Review Responses
use_cases.description: Draft concise follow-up comments after fixes are applied and verified locally.

use_cases.title: Coordinate Large Reviews
use_cases.description: Group many reviewer comments by priority and ask for approval before addressing them.

prompt_templates.title: Check Pull Request Comments
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner workflow for a small review.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to inspect comments on my current pull request. Summarize each comment and suggest the next action.

prompt_templates.title: Plan Review Fixes
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to fetch my PR comments, group them by file or topic, and propose an ordered fix plan.

prompt_templates.title: Address Selected Feedback
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused workflow for approved review items.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to address the comments I approve. Inspect the surrounding code, make the changes, and tell me what to test.

prompt_templates.title: Complete Review Follow-Up
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow after fixes are made.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to verify the changed files, prepare a reviewer response, and confirm the exact gh command before posting.

output_examples.input: Inspect my current pull request comments.
output_examples.output: The assistant reports authentication status, lists reviewer comments by topic, and identifies which comments need code changes.

output_examples.input: Plan fixes for the review comments before editing.
output: Comment group one needs a validation update.
Comment group two needs a test adjustment.
The assistant asks which group to address first.

output_examples.input: Prepare a response after the fixes are done.
output_examples.output: The assistant summarizes the completed fixes and asks for confirmation before posting a pull request comment.

best_practices: Confirm the target repository and pull request before running gh commands.
Read surrounding code before applying any reviewer suggestion.
Run relevant tests before posting that feedback has been addressed.
anti_patterns: Do not post a response before the requested change is implemented.
Do not run unknown helper scripts without reviewing them first.
Do not treat every reviewer comment as correct without checking context.

faq.question: Does this skill require GitHub CLI access?
faq.answer: Yes. It depends on the gh CLI and an authenticated GitHub session.

faq.question: Can it work on private repositories?
faq.answer: Yes, if the authenticated GitHub account has permission to view and comment on the pull request.

faq.question: Will it automatically post comments?
faq.answer: The workflow includes a posting command, but users should confirm the exact comment before it is sent.

faq.question: Does it make code changes directly?
faq.answer: It guides the agent to inspect feedback and apply selected fixes in the working tree.

faq.question: Can it resolve review threads?
faq.answer: It provides a general response workflow, but it does not include a dedicated thread resolution API command.

faq.question: What should I verify before using it?
faq.answer: Check gh authentication, the target pull request, local changes, and any tests related to the review feedback.
